uniqueValueProposition.usBreederRarity: 1 of only 5 active preservation Spanish Water Dog breeders in the United States.
uniqueValueProposition.founderDistinction: Youngest Spanish Water Dog breeder in America by 30 years, yet every bit as serious and rigorous as veteran preservation breeders.
uniqueValueProposition.mentorship: Mentored directly by Lisa Harper, a lifelong national board member and foundational pioneer who was instrumental in legitimizing the Spanish Water Dog in the United States.
uniqueValueProposition.nationalBreedClubLeadership: Former Member of the National Breed Club Board of Directors who modernized the club's official website and digital infrastructure for the 21st century.
uniqueValueProposition.whyNotShowingAtAkcConformationEveryWeeke: Instead of chasing weekend AKC conformation ribbons, Qbits dogs are proven as working medical service animals. At least one puppy from every Qbits litter is transferred into our Gotham Paw Service Animal Program.

serviceAnimalAndTherapyProgram.litterCommitment: At least 1 puppy from every Qbits litter is transferred into our Gotham Paw Service Animal Program.
primaryClinicalFocus: Spinal Cord Injuries (SCI — paraplegia, incomplete tetraplegia, ambulatory spinal cord injuries)
trainedTasks: Precision dropped-item retrieval (keys, phones, medication bottles, canes, credit cards, orthotics) without chewing
Tactile push-button activation for ADA power doors and elevator panels
Tugging straps to open or close drawers, refrigerator doors, and interior doors
Laundry assistance and assisting with removal of socks, shoes, or light jackets
Stationary counterbalance and momentum/transfer stability next to wheelchairs and walkers
Deep Pressure Therapy (DPT) for autonomic regulation and neuromuscular spasticity relief
Emergency alert bark or caregiver summons
serviceAnimalAndTherapyProgram.urgentApplicationNotice: Prospective service dog clients should contact Qbits Kennel (dog@cmejo.com) and Gotham Paw (https://gothampaw.netlify.app/services/service-animal/) AS SOON AS POSSIBLE, as evaluating, matching, and custom task-training a neurological service dog is an extraordinarily thorough multi-stage process.

legalDistinctions.taskTrainedServiceDog: Legally classified as a piece of medical equipment under the federal Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA). Individually trained to perform specific physical or neurological tasks that mitigate a person's disability. Grants full public access rights + Fair Housing Act (FHA) housing protection.
legalDistinctions.therapyDog: Provides comfort and affection to many people in hospitals, rehabilitation centers, nursing homes, and schools by invitation. Not medical equipment for the handler and has no general ADA public access rights.
legalDistinctions.emotionalSupportAnimalESA: Provides passive companionship to an individual with a mental or emotional condition; requires no task training. An ESA ONLY protects renters from being evicted or denied housing by a landlord that does not allow pets (under the Fair Housing Act) and has NO public access rights.
